author: NingMeng123
reference: R196 guarded runtime registry and decompiled classes
excluded: Eight metal knives follow the user exclusion, even though registered in R196.
modern_adaptations: 93 new tool identities; old iron/gold, shears, wood shovel and existing starters retain IDs.
Modern stone/diamond/netherite use durability factors 1/16/32; retain their modern target, attack, cooldown and use behavior.
New tools retain modern attack cooldown and add the recorded reach bonus to modern interaction range.

Modern block families and new counterparts are explicit targets; red sandstone follows sandstone, crying obsidian follows obsidian, ancient debris and netherite blocks require material level four for migrated tools.
Binding accepts either string or sinew consistently with the existing modern starter convention.
R196 right-click blocking and its incoming-damage formula remain pending; no unverified modern shield behavior is substituted.
Fertility/vampiric enchantments and missing crop diseases remain external dependencies; base hoe/scythe behavior is implemented.
Rusted tools have no fabricated crafting recipe. Source mob/loot acquisition remains part of future monster/loot migration.
Raw durability in this dataset precedes the effective quality multiplier; rusted tools clamp default average to their maximum POOR.
